site.footer: Prices in Saudi riyals. Requests are confirmed by the hotel.

home.title: Stays for pilgrims, near the Haram
home.lead: Choose a hotel and your dates, see the rooms that fit your family or group, and send a request. The hotel confirms it.
home.noHotels: No hotels are open for booking yet.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: We send you a code by e-mail or by text message. New here? The same code creates your account.
signIn.emailHelp: The code goes to this address.
signIn.emailInvalid: Enter an e-mail address like name{'@'}example.com.
signIn.phoneHelp: With the country code, for example +966 50 123 4567.
signIn.useEmail: Get the code by e-mail instead
signIn.usePhone: Get the code by text message instead
signIn.codeHelpEmail: The 6-digit code we e-mailed to {email}. Not there? Look in your spam folder.
signIn.fullNameHelp: As on your passport. Needed once, to create your account.

book.title: Book a stay
book.leadHelp: An adult of the booking, with their passport. You can add the others' details later.
book.requestNote: The hotel confirms or declines within a day. You can have one open request at a time.

bookings.title: My bookings
bookings.askHotel: To correct complete details, contact the hotel.
bookings.requestedNote: Waiting for the hotel to confirm. If it does not answer in time, the request expires by itself.
bookings.withdrawText: Booking {no} will be cancelled and its rooms let go.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.closeText: Your open request is withdrawn, your name and contact details are removed, and you are signed out everywhere. Past stays stay with the hotel.
account.stepUp: For your safety, confirm with a new code before closing the account.
